why: Record 0081 showed that three of the four guarantees this tool claimed did not exist, and that the fourth probe was red for the wrong reason: it deleted the file instead of contradicting the framework. Each probe below removes exactly one guarantee and must fail for that guarantee's own reason.

correctedClaim.claim: Probe 'a framework the project does not build' proved that guarantee.
correctedClaim.detail: It did not. The tool never opened a project file, so the probe was red only because no file sat at the path. The probe below leaves the file in place -- 79360 bytes at the net9.0 path -- and the run is red because the project declares netstandard2.0 and nothing else.

probes.probe: a framework the project does not build, with the file present
probes.expectation: red because the project declares only netstandard2.0, not because a file is missing
output: FAIL api-assemblies: 1 of 1 expected assemblies could not be collected:
ViciOne.ServiceBus.Analyzers: the census measures 'net9.0', which src/ViciOne.ServiceBus.Analyzers/ViciOne.ServiceBus.Analyzers.csproj does not build; it declares netstandard2.0

probes.probe: a claimed commit that is not the tree's HEAD
output: FAIL api-assemblies: --commit not-a-real-commit does not match the HEAD of ., which is 53b2e3995344fe7ec651a43a494c35942088f957

probes.probe: a text file carrying an expected assembly's name
probes.expectation: red because the metadata reader cannot identify it
output: FAIL api-assemblies: the surface reader could not read the collected assemblies, so their identity is unverified: Unhandled exception. System.BadImageFormatException: Unknown file format.
at System.Reflection.PortableExecutable.PEHeaders..ctor(Stream peStream, Int32 size, Boolean isLoadedImage)

probes.probe: census shrunk to one entry while expectedCount stays 33
output: FAIL api-assemblies: the census disagrees with itself: expectedCount is 33 but it lists 1 entries

probes.probe: duplicate assembly identity in the census
output: FAIL api-assemblies: duplicate assembly identity 'ViciOne.ServiceBus': claimed by src/ViciOne.ServiceBus/ViciOne.ServiceBus.csproj and by src/ViciOne.ServiceBus/ViciOne.ServiceBus.csproj

preventedByConstruction.case: a foreign assembly left in the output directory
preventedByConstruction.guarantee: the output directory is emptied before collecting, so the surface reader can only see censused files
preventedByConstruction.proof: A file ViciOne.ServiceBus.Schmuggel.dll was placed in the output directory before a run. Afterwards the directory held only ViciOne.ServiceBus.Analyzers.dll; the stray was gone. Reported as prevention rather than as a red probe, because the tool removes the condition instead of detecting it.
